text: どの　わざを　わすれさせるんだい？

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means to make someone do it. わすれさせる = 'make it forget'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, and with い on the end it becomes a friendly question asking for details. わすれさせるんだい = 'which is it that I should make it forget?'.
